Full findings and required changes: pantheon support/reviews/MGMT-PERF-IA-004-review-claude.md (PR #3255).
Resolved the seeded-fallback anti-pattern on Rankings Center. Verified with Vitest tests and npm run build. Merged execute-plans PR #262 (commit 17749f1).

Verified execute-plans PR #262 (commit 17749f1) removes the seeded-fallback anti-pattern from PersonaLeague/QuarterlyRanking, adds QuarterlyRanking seeded-row test coverage, and lands as a follow-up commit on dev. Reproduced 172/172 management vitest tests passing and npm run build succeeding in an isolated worktree at the merged commit. Approved; returning to owner for finalization.
